events.rationale: Audit produces a document (SECURITY_AUDIT.md) — no UI changes so design is skipped; single bounded output with no new system boundaries so architecture is skipped. Bug-fix template (scope → implementation → review → release) matches the workflow: implement the audit, review the findings, ship the document.

events.decision: Findings output is a committed SECURITY_AUDIT.md file, not inline task notes
events.rationale: A committed file persists with the codebase and can be referenced in future remediation PRs. It is reviewable as a diff like any other change, and the review stage can assess its completeness.

events.decision: Two highest-priority findings pre-identified in scope: mock mode auto-authentication (R1/R2) and inactive user bypass (R4/R11)
events.rationale: Code review during scoping confirmed: (1) AuthContext.jsx:10-11 initializes with MOCK_USER when supabaseConfigured is false — a production deployment without env vars silently authenticates everyone; (2) user_metadata.status is user-writable via Supabase client updateUser, so admin deactivation can be self-reversed by the targeted user.

events.summary: Full scope pushed as revision 2. 12 requirements across 5 domains (mock mode bypass, access control, input validation, Edge Function security, CSP headers). Single implementation phase produces SECURITY_AUDIT.md. Two critical pre-identified findings: (1) AuthContext initializes authenticated when Supabase env vars are absent; (2) user_metadata.status is user-writable so admin deactivation can be self-reversed. Workflow: bug-fix (scope → implementation → review → release).

events.rationale: Routine sync drift: HEAD fast-forwarded (stale HEAD is a strict ancestor of current) with a byte-identical dirty-status digest; swept forward automatically without waking an agent.
